sources.title: Apple launches its new touchscreen MacBook Pro
passages: After years of resisting, Apple today launched a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen starting at $2,899.
The new Touchscreen MacBook marks two marquee product launches for new CEO John Ternus, who also introduced the company’s first foldable, the iPhone Duo, in September .
Various Apple executives, including Steve Jobs and Tim Cook, have scoffed at the idea of a touchscreen Mac in the past.
The new MacBook Pro more fully embraces the touchscreen, offering a new PROLED XDR Display in both 14-inch and 16-inch screen sizes.
The device is powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips as options to choose from, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 16TB of storage.
The display has 2,000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness and a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio.
This also helps to stabilize the camera when you are on a video call and trying to access content on the display.

extraction.body: After years of resisting, Apple today launched a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen starting at $2,899. The release comes nearly 10 years after the company first tried integrating touchscreens on its laptops, with its Touch Bar on a MacBook Pro , which it later went on to remove . The new MacBook Pro more fully embraces the touchscreen, offering a new PROLED XDR Display in both 14-inch and 16-inch screen sizes. The device is powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips as options to choose from, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 16TB of storage. The display has 2,000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness and a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio. To make the new MacBook easy to use, Apple designed a hinge that stabilizes the screen when users touch it. This also helps to stabilize the camera when you are on a video call and trying to access content on the display. In addition, the screen will include a Dynamic Island-style cutout instead of the notch that’s present on most of the current MacBooks. Plus, the new MacBook features a six-speaker array with a new woofer design for better sound. The 14-inch Pro weighs 3.0 pounds (1.38 kg), and the 16-inch Pro weighs 4.0 pounds (1.82 kg) — lighter than its non-touch predecessors. Both feature three Thunderbolt 5 ports, an HDMI port, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. Users can hook up three external displays on the M5 Pro variant and up to four displays on the M5 Max variant. The Touchscreen MacBook Pro 14-inch starts at $2,899, and the 16-inch version starts at $3,399. Consumers can place a preorder for the new touchscreen MacBook Pro from October 30, and the device will be available starting November 6. The new Touchscreen MacBook marks two marquee product launches for new CEO John Ternus, who also introduced the company’s first foldable, the iPhone Duo, in September . Various Apple executives, including Steve Jobs and Tim Cook, have scoffed at the idea of a touchscreen Mac in the past. Jobs famously called the idea “ergonomically terrible” at one point. However, rumors of the company working on such a variant started circulating nearly three years before today’s introduction . The launch follows yesterday’s unveiling of a new standard MacBook Pro with the M6 chip in 14-inch size starting from $1,999 . sources.title: MacBook Pro: Apple launches its first ever touchscreen Mac – and brings back iconic feature - The Independent
passages: Apple has launched an entirely new version of the MacBook Pro, its first-ever touchscreen Mac, after years of saying that it would never make one .
But Apple appeared to stress the benefits of its new OLED display more than the touchscreen feature, stressing its brightness, contrast and colours.
The announcement comes at the end of a busy week, which has also seen Apple introduce a new iPad Mini, as well as updated iMacs and lower-end MacBook Pro models.
That is compared with a starting price of $1,999 for the non-touchscreen version, though that also includes a less powerful chip.
New touch sensitive laptop brings back glowing Apple logo on the back, alongside lighter design
The display allows for more vivid colours, blacker blacks and better contrast, Apple said.
All of those new features and changes are enabled by a new screen technology that Apple calls PROLED XDR.
The introduction of touch will allow users to more easily do normal actions such as moving windows around, scrolling, and placing content, Apple said.

But it suggested it would also open up new ways of interacting with the Mac entirely, such as letting artists draw on it, musicians play software instruments with the screen, and allowing developers to test their apps as if they were being used on an iPhone or iPad.
Many other companies have long offered touchscreen laptops.

That is despite the fact that many of its executives, including new chief executive John Ternus, have previously dismissed the idea – primarily because of the ergonomic troubles of reaching out across the keyboard to touch the display.
It comes amid a broader push into new kinds of formats for its devices, including a new foldable phone and display for the home.

The company had to make a number of other changes to allow for the introduction of touch. The introduction of touch will allow users to more easily do normal actions such as moving windows around, scrolling, and placing content, Apple said. The announcement comes at the end of a busy week, which has also seen Apple introduce a new iPad Mini, as well as updated iMacs and lower-end MacBook Pro models. passages: The laptop is scheduled to be available from November 9.Apple MacBook Pro: What's new A look at Apple's first-ever touchscreen laptop.The touchscreen is the biggest change to Apple's professional laptop.
Apple has finally brought touchscreen support to the MacBook Pro, ending its long-standing resistance to adding touch controls to its laptops.

Two years later, former CEO Tim Cook argued against combining tablets and laptops, comparing the idea to converging a toaster and a refrigerator.Apple later experimented with the Touch Bar, a touch-sensitive strip that replaced the function keys on MacBook Pro models introduced in 2016.

Apple says the feature will also benefit professional workflows, allowing designers to interact with 3D models and music producers to adjust controls using their fingers.Apple has redesigned the interface to make touch interactions more natural while retaining the traditional keyboard and trackpad experience.

Apple is also offering a nano-texture option to reduce reflections.The new models are powered by the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, which are designed for demanding tasks such as video editing, 3D rendering, software development and AI workloads.
It provides access to Spotlight search, Live Activities, music controls and other information from the top of the screen.The laptop uses a tandem OLED display, which Apple calls PROLED XDR.

Two new models will be available for pre-order at 1:10 AM on October 29, with official shipping beginning on November 6. The new iMac starts at RMB 12,499, and the MacBook Pro starts at RMB 15,999. Apple stated that the M6 chip enables the new iMac to deliver five times the performance on AI tasks compared to the previous generation, while the entry-level MacBook Pro offers a 30% improvement in graphics processing over its predecessor. This release is the second wave of Apple’s product launch campaign this week. On Monday, the company updated the iPad mini with an upgraded display and water-resistant features. Wall Street Journal noted that Apple will conclude its product releases this week on Wednesday with its first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro. The new iMac and MacBook Pro closely resemble their predecessors in design, with main changes focused on internal hardware. Both models feature the M6 chip—first introduced in September alongside the Mac mini. In this update, the iMac has jumped from the M4 chip to the M6 chip, while the MacBook Pro only received the M5 chip last year, resulting in a relatively shorter iteration cycle. In terms of connectivity, both new devices support Bluetooth 6 and Wi-Fi 7, and the new MacBook Pro also features faster charging. Apple continues to sell the high-end MacBook Pro models equipped with the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, both of which feature higher specifications for the main processor and graphics cores compared to the newly released entry-level M6 model. Apple's Mac line of devices accounted for $33.7 billion of the company's $416.1 billion in 2025, making it the tech giant's fourth-largest segment by sales. The Macs come a day after Apple debuted its newest iPad mini, which received a larger, improved display and new processor. The company is expected to cap off its announcements on Wednesday with the launch of its first-ever touchscreen-equipped MacBook. Apple has stepped up the cadence of product launches in the second half of the year, bringing out everything from new processors and desktops to AirPods, watches, and more. On Monday, Apple responded to early reports of some Duo displays breaking along the hinge, saying that it is aware of the matter and urging users to contact Apple support for replacement devices.

extraction.body: This week, Apple released a series of new products in rapid succession, launching the 24-inch iMac and 14-inch entry-level MacBook Pro with the M6 chip ahead of the touchscreen MacBook Pro's debut. Two new models will be available for pre-order at 1:10 AM on October 29, with official shipping beginning on November 6. The new iMac starts at RMB 12,499, and the MacBook Pro starts at RMB 15,999. Apple stated that the M6 chip enables the new iMac to deliver five times the performance on AI tasks compared to the previous generation, while the entry-level MacBook Pro offers a 30% improvement in graphics processing over its predecessor. This release is the second wave of Apple’s product launch campaign this week. On Monday, the company updated the iPad mini with an upgraded display and water-resistant features. Wall Street Journal noted that Apple will conclude its product releases this week on Wednesday with its first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro. The new iMac and MacBook Pro closely resemble their predecessors in design, with main changes focused on internal hardware. Both models feature the M6 chip—first introduced in September alongside the Mac mini. In this update, the iMac has jumped from the M4 chip to the M6 chip, while the MacBook Pro only received the M5 chip last year, resulting in a relatively shorter iteration cycle. In terms of connectivity, both new devices support Bluetooth 6 and Wi-Fi 7, and the new MacBook Pro also features faster charging. Apple continues to sell the high-end MacBook Pro models equipped with the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, both of which feature higher specifications for the main processor and graphics cores compared to the newly released entry-level M6 model. Apple will release its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen this Wednesday, ending the company’s two-decade-long resistance to touchscreens on laptops. The new touch-screen MacBook Pro will feature a lighter and thinner design, narrower screen bezels, and the introduction of OLED display technology. This round of intensive updates is part of Apple’s broader product roadmap. According to Bloomberg, Apple also plans to launch refreshed versions of the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air in the first half of next year, aside from the touchscreen MacBook Pro. On the chip roadmap, Apple is expected to release the M7, M7 Pro, and M7 Max chips in 2027, along with a redesigned entry-level MacBook Pro; the M7 Ultra chip and a new Mac Studio are scheduled for release in 2028. Apple is continuing its comprehensive overhaul of its computer lineup to meet growing demands for artificial intelligence applications; the two new products released today are milestones in this journey, not the final destination.

extraction.body: The updated iMac and low-end MacBook Pro become available for pre-ordering on Oct 28 and arrive beginning Nov 6. Apple has rolled out a new 24-inch iMac and an entry-level MacBook Pro with a 14-inch screen, marking key updates in an end-to-end overhaul of the company’s computer line. The new iMac and MacBook Pro, unveiled on Oct 27 , are visually similar to their predecessors – with the main changes happening internally. Both machines now include the M6 chip, which debuted in the Mac mini in September. The iMac is moving from an M4 processor, while the MacBook Pro received the M5 in 2025 . The updates represent a second day of Apple announcements this week, with the company rolling out a revamped iPad mini on Oct 26 with a new screen and water resistance. Apple will cap the launches on Oct 28 with its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen, Bloomberg News has reported. The updated iMac and low-end MacBook Pro become available for pre-orders on Oct 28 and will arrive beginning Nov 6, Apple said, matching the new iPad mini. The new iMac starts at US$1,499 (S$1,920), while the MacBook Pro begins at US$1,999. Apple said the M6 chip makes the iMac five times faster than the prior model from 2024 for artificial intelligence, while the new MacBook Pro is 30% speedier than its predecessor for graphics. The company continues to sell higher-end M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pros, which have more advanced main processing and graphics cores compared with the entry M6 machines. The updated 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac also include Bluetooth 6 and Wi-Fi 7, while the laptop gets faster charging. Both machines go on sale Nov. 6 after pre-orders open on Oct 28 . The new Macs come as part of a slew of changes to the company’s computer line. Beyond the push into touchscreen displays, Apple is preparing a refreshed MacBook Neo and MacBook Air for the first half of 2027 . The company is also working on a redesigned low-end MacBook Pro and the release of its first M7, M7 Pro and M7 Max chips in 2027. It is planning an M7 Ultra and a new Mac Studio in 2028. Apple’s overhauled MacBook Pro with a touchscreen – coming on Oct 28 – will include a lighter and slightly thinner design, slimmer bezels around the display and OLED technology, Bloomberg reported.

sources.title: Amazon overhauls aging devices lineup with higher-priced Alexa tablet, dumping the budget Fire - CNBC
passages: Amazon on Thursday debuted a set of new, pricier Alexa tablets and said it's ditching its budget-friendly Fire lineup, marking a significant shift in the e-commerce juggernaut's devices strategy.
Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet.
But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs."
Alexa is front and center in the new tablets, via a "dynamic tab" on the home screen that offers recommendations and lets users quickly pick up where they left off reading or watching a TV show.
Users can say "Alexa" or tap the "Ask Alexa" button to ask questions.
The Fire lineup includes a 10-inch and 8-inch model as well as two versions targeted for kids.
The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple 's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199.
Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors.
The launch comes as Amazon and other device makers are grappling with a historic surge in memory prices .
Amazon in August boosted prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs and other hardware, citing the memory crunch.
In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video.
Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said.

Amazon has historically sold its devices at or near the cost of manufacturing them, partly to undercut competitors with extremely cheap prices, but also with the goal of promoting its other products and services.
It's hoped that for every $80 Echo smart speaker it sells, users will purchase movies, audiobook subscriptions or items from its sprawling webstore, which tend to have higher margins.
The company has recently taken steps to make more money from its devices business under CEO Andy Jassy , who succeeded founder Jeff Bezos in 2021.
Last year, it introduced pricier versions of its Echo smart speakers and began charging non-Prime members a subscription for Alexa+ , the souped-up version of its digital assistant.
"I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview.
"They gave you the full craftsmanship of a product, but are able to keep it at that price point."

extraction.body: Amazon on Thursday debuted a set of new, pricier Alexa tablets and said it's ditching its budget-friendly Fire lineup, marking a significant shift in the e-commerce juggernaut's devices strategy. The company unveiled 8-inch, 11-inch and 12-inch models, which start at $230 and run up to $550. All devices are available for preorder on Thursday and will begin shipping Oct. 14. Amazon has historically sold its devices at or near the cost of manufacturing them, partly to undercut competitors with extremely cheap prices, but also with the goal of promoting its other products and services. It's hoped that for every $80 Echo smart speaker it sells, users will purchase movies, audiobook subscriptions or items from its sprawling webstore, which tend to have higher margins. The company has recently taken steps to make more money from its devices business under CEO Andy Jassy , who succeeded founder Jeff Bezos in 2021. Last year, it introduced pricier versions of its Echo smart speakers and began charging non-Prime members a subscription for Alexa+ , the souped-up version of its digital assistant. The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple 's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199. The launch comes as Amazon and other device makers are grappling with a historic surge in memory prices . Amazon in August boosted prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs and other hardware, citing the memory crunch. And earlier this year, Apple raised its prices on MacBooks and iPads, while Nintendo hiked the price of its Switch 2 console. Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet. But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs." "I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview. "They gave you the full craftsmanship of a product, but are able to keep it at that price point." The company said the Alexa tablet's improved speed and performance, artificial intelligence features, and upgraded design warrant a higher price tag and put the devices on par with "the best tablets on the market." Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors. On the Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, the highest-end model, it incorporated "Nanomatte" display technology that was developed in partnership with Corning to "dramatically reduce screen glare." One of the most notable upgrades is that all of the devices run Google 's Android operating system, a major departure from earlier models, which relied on a custom Android version dubbed Fire OS and used Amazon's own app store, limiting the number of apps that were available. It's also the first time Amazon has attached a set of devices to the Alexa brand, the company's automated assistant first launched in 2014 via the Echo smart speaker. Alexa is front and center in the new tablets, via a "dynamic tab" on the home screen that offers recommendations and lets users quickly pick up where they left off reading or watching a TV show. Users can say "Alexa" or tap the "Ask Alexa" button to ask questions. The company also introduced a new feature called "On-Screen Intelligence," where users can ask Alexa to look at what's on their screen and make suggestions or take actions. In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video. Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said. "She'll do the homework, and if things work out, she's going to bring up a shopping list where I can just hit buy now," Panay said. Amazon said it will continue to support the Fire lineup for four years after the final shipment and consumers can continue using their devices as they do today, but it is no longer manufacturing new units. relevantPassages.text: Amazon on Thursday debuted a set of new, pricier Alexa tablets and said it's ditching its budget-friendly Fire lineup, marking a significant shift in the e-commerce juggernaut's devices strategy.
Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet.
But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs."
Alexa is front and center in the new tablets, via a "dynamic tab" on the home screen that offers recommendations and lets users quickly pick up where they left off reading or watching a TV show.
Users can say "Alexa" or tap the "Ask Alexa" button to ask questions.
The Fire lineup includes a 10-inch and 8-inch model as well as two versions targeted for kids.
The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple 's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199.
Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors.
The launch comes as Amazon and other device makers are grappling with a historic surge in memory prices .
Amazon in August boosted prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs and other hardware, citing the memory crunch.
In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video.
Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said.

Amazon has historically sold its devices at or near the cost of manufacturing them, partly to undercut competitors with extremely cheap prices, but also with the goal of promoting its other products and services.
It's hoped that for every $80 Echo smart speaker it sells, users will purchase movies, audiobook subscriptions or items from its sprawling webstore, which tend to have higher margins.
The company has recently taken steps to make more money from its devices business under CEO Andy Jassy , who succeeded founder Jeff Bezos in 2021.
Last year, it introduced pricier versions of its Echo smart speakers and began charging non-Prime members a subscription for Alexa+ , the souped-up version of its digital assistant.
"I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview.
"They gave you the full craftsmanship of a product, but are able to keep it at that price point."

passages: Today, Amazon announced the latest generation of Alexa devices , each designed for Alexa+ and purpose-built for the moments and tasks customers turn to Alexa for most.
The next-generation Echo Dot is designed for everywhere you can imagine and packs even more into its compact form factor.

For the first time, it includes a built-in smart home hub, so Alexa connects to hundreds of compatible devices such as lights, locks, thermostats right out of the box, plus a built-in eero Wi-Fi extender that adds up to 93 square metres of coverage to your existing network.
At its core is Amazon’s custom AZ3 silicon, with a new AI Accelerator built for on-device AI that sharpens conversational detection and filters out background noise.
Music, audiobooks, and podcasts sound great on the new Echo Dot, with crisp vocals and 50% more bass than its predecessor.
Echo Studio with Home Camera takes Amazon's best-sounding speaker and gives it a richer understanding of the room around it, making Alexa even more useful.
The camera enables a new Adaptive Volume feature that optimises playback as you move throughout the room.

What's new is context: with more awareness of its surroundings, Alexa can help in real time —explaining the rules on a board game box you hold up, recognizing a box of cereal to help you reorder it, or letting you check in on the room from the Alexa app while you're away.
Privacy is built into every Echo device from the ground up, and customers are in control of their experience.
There are clear visual indicators when Alexa is listening, and a dedicated privacy button turns the microphones off completely.

• The Echo Show 16, which has a 16-inch screen, built-in Fire TV and Amazon's first Echo Show camera with night vision, is available for pre-order from $499.99
• A new Echo Studio speaker with a built-in camera, which lets Alexa recognize objects held up to it and lets users check on a room remotely, costs $249.99

CNA Games Guess Word Crack the word, one row at a time Buzzword Create words using the given letters Mini Sudoku Tiny puzzle, mighty brain teaser Mini Crossword Small grid, big challenge Word Search Spot as many words as you can Show More Show Less • The new Echo Dot, priced at $99.99, includes a built-in smart home hub and Wi-Fi extender for the first time
• Echo Time, a $199.99 bedside clock, uses sleep-sensing technology to wake users during lighter sleep, without a wearable device

• Earlier this month, Apple launched HomeView, a $299 smart home device with a 7-inch screen and face recognition, and HomePod mini 2, a $149 smart speaker
• Amazon is rolling out the devices as it faces growing competition from rivals including Apple, as well as AI companies such as OpenAI that have hardware ambitions.

coreStoryFacts.text: Amazon on Thursday debuted a set of new, pricier Alexa tablets and said it's ditching its budget-friendly Fire lineup, marking a significant shift in the e-commerce juggernaut's devices strategy.
Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet.
But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs."
Alexa is front and center in the new tablets, via a "dynamic tab" on the home screen that offers recommendations and lets users quickly pick up where they left off reading or watching a TV show.
Users can say "Alexa" or tap the "Ask Alexa" button to ask questions.
The Fire lineup includes a 10-inch and 8-inch model as well as two versions targeted for kids.
The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple 's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199.
Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors.
The launch comes as Amazon and other device makers are grappling with a historic surge in memory prices .
Amazon in August boosted prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs and other hardware, citing the memory crunch.
In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video.
Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said.

Amazon has historically sold its devices at or near the cost of manufacturing them, partly to undercut competitors with extremely cheap prices, but also with the goal of promoting its other products and services.
It's hoped that for every $80 Echo smart speaker it sells, users will purchase movies, audiobook subscriptions or items from its sprawling webstore, which tend to have higher margins.
The company has recently taken steps to make more money from its devices business under CEO Andy Jassy , who succeeded founder Jeff Bezos in 2021.
Last year, it introduced pricier versions of its Echo smart speakers and began charging non-Prime members a subscription for Alexa+ , the souped-up version of its digital assistant.
"I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview.
"They gave you the full craftsmanship of a product, but are able to keep it at that price point."
Today, Amazon announced the latest generation of Alexa devices , each designed for Alexa+ and purpose-built for the moments and tasks customers turn to Alexa for most.
The next-generation Echo Dot is designed for everywhere you can imagine and packs even more into its compact form factor.

For the first time, it includes a built-in smart home hub, so Alexa connects to hundreds of compatible devices such as lights, locks, thermostats right out of the box, plus a built-in eero Wi-Fi extender that adds up to 93 square metres of coverage to your existing network.
At its core is Amazon’s custom AZ3 silicon, with a new AI Accelerator built for on-device AI that sharpens conversational detection and filters out background noise.
Music, audiobooks, and podcasts sound great on the new Echo Dot, with crisp vocals and 50% more bass than its predecessor.
Echo Studio with Home Camera takes Amazon's best-sounding speaker and gives it a richer understanding of the room around it, making Alexa even more useful.

sources.title: Amazon overhauls aging devices lineup with higher-priced Alexa tablet, dumping the budget Fire - CNBC
passages: Amazon on Thursday debuted a set of new, pricier Alexa tablets and said it's ditching its budget-friendly Fire lineup, marking a significant shift in the e-commerce juggernaut's devices strategy.
Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet.
But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs."
Alexa is front and center in the new tablets, via a "dynamic tab" on the home screen that offers recommendations and lets users quickly pick up where they left off reading or watching a TV show.
Users can say "Alexa" or tap the "Ask Alexa" button to ask questions.
The Fire lineup includes a 10-inch and 8-inch model as well as two versions targeted for kids.
The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple 's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199.
Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors.
The launch comes as Amazon and other device makers are grappling with a historic surge in memory prices .
Amazon in August boosted prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs and other hardware, citing the memory crunch.
In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video.
Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said.

Amazon has historically sold its devices at or near the cost of manufacturing them, partly to undercut competitors with extremely cheap prices, but also with the goal of promoting its other products and services.
It's hoped that for every $80 Echo smart speaker it sells, users will purchase movies, audiobook subscriptions or items from its sprawling webstore, which tend to have higher margins.
The company has recently taken steps to make more money from its devices business under CEO Andy Jassy , who succeeded founder Jeff Bezos in 2021.
Last year, it introduced pricier versions of its Echo smart speakers and began charging non-Prime members a subscription for Alexa+ , the souped-up version of its digital assistant.
"I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview.
"They gave you the full craftsmanship of a product, but are able to keep it at that price point."

The company unveiled 8-inch, 11-inch and 12-inch models, which start at $230 and run up to $550. All devices are available for preorder on Thursday and will begin shipping Oct. 14. Amazon has historically sold its devices at or near the cost of manufacturing them, partly to undercut competitors with extremely cheap prices, but also with the goal of promoting its other products and services. It's hoped that for every $80 Echo smart speaker it sells, users will purchase movies, audiobook subscriptions or items from its sprawling webstore, which tend to have higher margins. The company has recently taken steps to make more money from its devices business under CEO Andy Jassy , who succeeded founder Jeff Bezos in 2021. Last year, it introduced pricier versions of its Echo smart speakers and began charging non-Prime members a subscription for Alexa+ , the souped-up version of its digital assistant. The $550 Alexa Tablet 12 Pro costs more than double the price of the $155 Fire HD 10, Amazon's base model, and puts it more in line with Apple 's iPad, which runs from $449 to $1,199. The launch comes as Amazon and other device makers are grappling with a historic surge in memory prices . Amazon in August boosted prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs and other hardware, citing the memory crunch. And earlier this year, Apple raised its prices on MacBooks and iPads, while Nintendo hiked the price of its Switch 2 console. Amazon denied that rising memory costs played a role in its decision to charge more for the Alexa tablet. But Panos Panay, the company's devices boss, acknowledged that the shortage made it "quite tricky" to build a premium tablet at a reasonable price without making any "trade-offs." "I think the team did a good job designing without making that trade," Panay told CNBC in an interview. "They gave you the full craftsmanship of a product, but are able to keep it at that price point." The company said the Alexa tablet's improved speed and performance, artificial intelligence features, and upgraded design warrant a higher price tag and put the devices on par with "the best tablets on the market." Amazon added a sleeker, sturdier aluminum backing, higher resolution display and faster processors. On the Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, the highest-end model, it incorporated "Nanomatte" display technology that was developed in partnership with Corning to "dramatically reduce screen glare." One of the most notable upgrades is that all of the devices run Google 's Android operating system, a major departure from earlier models, which relied on a custom Android version dubbed Fire OS and used Amazon's own app store, limiting the number of apps that were available. It's also the first time Amazon has attached a set of devices to the Alexa brand, the company's automated assistant first launched in 2014 via the Echo smart speaker. Users can say "Alexa" or tap the "Ask Alexa" button to ask questions. In a demo, Panay showed how users could watch a TikTok clip of someone cooking on a grill and ask Alexa to shop for a burger press used in the video. Users can also pull up a game schedule and add every date to their calendar, Amazon said. "She'll do the homework, and if things work out, she's going to bring up a shopping list where I can just hit buy now," Panay said. Make it yours with hundreds of clock faces to choose from—including everything from analog and modern to playful designs and weather themes. passages: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch for the first time on Mac
The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI.
2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes.
An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio.
2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.
“PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display.
It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of.
Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined.

Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place.
And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.
PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges.
2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.
Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets.
Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them.
7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.
The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27.

Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.

Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item.
Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users.

Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display.
And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love.

In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience.
3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.
Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch.

These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.
Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands.

It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors.
It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain.
As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.
Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows.

M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video.
M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers.

With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before.
Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV.
Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows. M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video. M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers. With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production. A powerful Neural Accelerator built into each GPU core lets users speed through AI workloads like running a coding agent with an on-device LLM. And users are able to power through advanced graphics-intensive tasks like rendering a complex scene in Cinema 4D with Redshift. M5 Pro and M5 Max each feature a GPU with enhanced shader cores and a third-generation ray-tracing engine, delivering more photorealistic lighting and faster renders for 3D modeling. Dynamic Caching optimizes on-chip memory to significantly increase GPU utilization, driving huge performance boosts for apps like Blender and Unreal Engine, along with AAA games. The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work. The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. 7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed. The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. 3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB. The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined. MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new MacBook Pro is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled. Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

sources.title: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display - MacDailyNews
passages: Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance.
The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI.
An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio.
It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.
“PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display.
PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges.
2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.
Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets.
Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them.
With Pixelmator Pro, creators can interact with their designs directly on the canvas, making use of the fully interactive display to draw, paint, and select with even more fluidity.
In Logic Pro, musicians can play software instruments with a fully Multi-Touch polyphonic keyboard, along with tappable chord and drum pads onscreen.
And in Final Cut Pro, editors can use Touch to precisely mark ranges, drop clips directly into place, pinch to zoom in on a cut, and more.
And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.
Additional configure-to-order options are available at apple.com/macbook-pro .
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience.
With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes.
In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.

It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall,9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors.
It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain.
As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based10 and designed to be recycled.
• With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac.

Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments, and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front.

In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable.

Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.

Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item.
Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch.

These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before.
Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands.

And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.
And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.
Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users.
And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love.

In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.
• The Apple Pro Display Calibrator gives pros the ability to calibrate their display to specific targets.
• AppleCare delivers exceptional service and support, with flexible options for Apple users.
Both plans include coverage for accidents like drops and spills, battery replacement service, and priority support from Apple Experts.
For more information, visit apple.com/applecare .

passages: Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI. And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes.3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer, in a statement. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.”
PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop

The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go.

PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display.
The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows

PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go.

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.

Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.

The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner.

With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display.

The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.

The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.

• The Apple Pro Display Calibrator gives pros the ability to calibrate their display to specific targets. In addition, pros can take advantage of industry-standard reference modes for cinematic standards, photography, print, design, and more. And with new DICOM medical imaging reference modes, the display can be used today to review medical images with outstanding grayscale accuracy and contrast when used for nondiagnostic reviews, research, and educational purposes.
• Through Apple Color Matching Function 2026 , the PROLED XDR display delivers a seamless, consistent visual experience when paired with iPhone 18 Pro or Studio Display XDR.

• With support for genlock , MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display synchronizes a display’s refresh rate with a camera’s capture to minimize ghosting, tearing, and other visual artifacts when filming, making it highly valuable for virtual productions and on-set work.8

• Apple Creator Studio opens up new ways to create on MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, optimizing for Touch alongside the precision of the keyboard and trackpad. With Pixelmator Pro, creators can interact with their designs directly on the canvas, making use of the fully interactive display to draw, paint, and select with even more fluidity. In Logic Pro, musicians can play software instruments with a fully Multi-Touch polyphonic keyboard, along with tappable chord and drum pads onscreen. And in Final Cut Pro, editors can use Touch to precisely mark ranges, drop clips directly into place, pinch to zoom in on a cut, and more.

The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.

The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.

Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment

The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall,9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new MacBook Pro is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based10 and designed to be recycled.

“PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display.

2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.
Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets.
Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them.
With Pixelmator Pro, creators can interact with their designs directly on the canvas, making use of the fully interactive display to draw, paint, and select with even more fluidity.
In Logic Pro, musicians can play software instruments with a fully Multi-Touch polyphonic keyboard, along with tappable chord and drum pads onscreen.
And in Final Cut Pro, editors can use Touch to precisely mark ranges, drop clips directly into place, pinch to zoom in on a cut, and more.
And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.
Additional configure-to-order options are available at apple.com/macbook-pro .
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience.

• With Apple Trade In, customers can trade in their current computer and get credit toward a new Mac.

Customers in the U.S. who shop at Apple using Apple Card can pay monthly at 0 percent APR when they choose to check out with Apple Card Monthly Installments, and they’ll get 3 percent Daily Cash back — all up front.

In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable.

Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.

Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item.
Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch.

These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before.

And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.
And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.
Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users.
And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love.

In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.
• The Apple Pro Display Calibrator gives pros the ability to calibrate their display to specific targets.
• AppleCare delivers exceptional service and support, with flexible options for Apple users.
Both plans include coverage for accidents like drops and spills, battery replacement service, and priority support from Apple Experts.
For more information, visit apple.com/applecare .

passages: Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI. And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes.3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer, in a statement. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.”
PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop

The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go.

PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display.
The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows

PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go.

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.

Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.

The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner.

With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display.

The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.

The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.

In addition, pros can take advantage of industry-standard reference modes for cinematic standards, photography, print, design, and more. With Pixelmator Pro, creators can interact with their designs directly on the canvas, making use of the fully interactive display to draw, paint, and select with even more fluidity. In Logic Pro, musicians can play software instruments with a fully Multi-Touch polyphonic keyboard, along with tappable chord and drum pads onscreen.
